question_text: Identify the passive form: 'The students are completing the CBT exam right now.'

The CBT exam is being completed by the students right now.

explanation: Present Continuous Passive: Subject + am/is/are + being + V3.

explanation: Karena semua dokter mengenakan jas putih dan sebagian orang di rumah sakit mengenakan jas putih, maka sebagian orang tersebut adalah dokter.
